name: vector_db_search
description: Searches the agent's long-term vector memory for previously stored findings, 10-K risk factors, earnings transcripts, and company metrics. Invoke this BEFORE external calls when seeking previously gathered research or session findings.

query.description: The semantic search query (e.g. 'cloud revenue growth', 'risk factors', 'margin trends').

source_type.description: Optional source type filter (e.g., SEC_10K, NEWS, EARNINGS_TRANSCRIPT).
